description: Reasoning Schemas & Problem-Solving Archetypes for Negative Integers, Absolute Value, Signed Arithmetic Rules, and Linear Equations.

archetypes.name: Signed Elevation/Temperature Absolute Range (ความแตกต่างของค่าติดลบและบวกในโลกจริง)
archetypes.coreConcept: Computing net distance or range between positive and negative values across zero: Delta = y - x.
mentalModel: 1. Identify the reference initial value and terminal value.
2. Set up the difference expression: terminal - initial.
3. Subtracting a negative integer becomes adding its positive magnitude.

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting positive magnitudes directly, ignoring the negative direction.

versatileDomains.description: Measuring extreme diurnal air temperature shifts.
Measuring vertical distance between surface and ocean trench.

archetypes.name: Bank Overdraft Ledger Cumulative Balance (การบันทึกยอดเงินติดลบและการฝากถอน)
archetypes.coreConcept: Successive deposits (positive) and debits (negative) update an integer balance.
mentalModel: 1. Represent overdrawn balance as a negative integer.
2. Represent credit deposit as a positive integer.
3. Add signed quantities to find the resulting balance.

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding both numbers as positive magnitudes without acknowledging debt.

versatileDomains.description: Tracking corporate checking balance after overdraft resolution.
Balancing emergency branch cash drawers.

archetypes.name: Signed Addition with Opposite Signs (การบวกจำนวนเต็มต่างเครื่องหมาย)
archetypes.coreConcept: Adding integers of opposite signs requires taking the difference of their absolute values and preserving the sign of the larger magnitude.
mentalModel: 1. Compare absolute values of the two addends.
2. Subtract the smaller absolute value from the larger.
3. Affix the sign of the addend with the greater absolute value.

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding magnitudes together and blindly making the result negative.

versatileDomains.description: Reconciling damaged returns against incoming shipments.
Balancing regional power generation vs deficit draw.

archetypes.name: Signed Subtraction as Adding the Opposite (การลบจำนวนเต็มด้วยการบวกจำนวนตรงข้าม)
archetypes.coreConcept: Subtracting an integer is algebraically equivalent to adding its additive inverse: a - b = a + (-b).
mentalModel: 1. Identify the minuend and subtrahend.
2. Transform subtraction into addition of the opposite.
3. Combine according to signed addition rules.

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting absolute values instead of accumulating negative totals.

versatileDomains.description: Tracking descent of mining elevator cage deeper below surface.
Applying sequential negative orbital altitude adjustments.

archetypes.name: Signed Multiplication Parity & Scaling (การคูณจำนวนเต็มและสมบัติเครื่องหมาย)
archetypes.coreConcept: The product of two negative integers is strictly positive: (-a) * (-b) = ab.
mentalModel: 1. Count the number of negative signs among the factors.
2. An even count of negative factors yields a positive product.
3. Multiply absolute values.

cognitiveTraps.description: Retaining a negative sign in the product of two negative factors.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating gains from negative price movement in short positions.
Scaling thermal extraction across multiple refrigeration stages.

archetypes.name: Signed Integer Division Partitioning (การหารจำนวนเต็มลบและเครื่องหมายผลหาร)
archetypes.coreConcept: Dividing integers with unlike signs produces a negative quotient: (-A) / B = -(A / B). L3 problem form: show a worked solution that makes the mistake 'Dropping the negative sign, producing a positive quotient (tag `c03-division-sign-inversion-trap`)'; the learner finds the faulty step and gives the correct result.
mentalModel: 1. Divide absolute magnitudes to find base numerical quotient.
2. Determine quotient sign: opposite signs yield negative.
3. Verify by checking product of divisor and quotient.

cognitiveTraps.description: Dropping the negative sign, producing a positive quotient.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating average periodic reduction from total quarterly debt.
Determining hourly pressure change during controlled blowdown.

archetypes.name: Signed Order of Operations with Nested Negatives (ลำดับการคำนวณจำนวนเต็มพร้อมวงเล็บและเครื่องหมายลบ)
archetypes.coreConcept: Operator precedence strictly governs expressions with signed values: multiplication precedes subtraction. L3 problem form: show a worked solution that makes the mistake 'Subtracting before multiplying negative factor (tag `c03-pemdas-signed-left-to-right-bias`)'; the learner finds the faulty step and gives the correct result.
mentalModel: 1. Perform multiplications involving signed factors first.
2. Rewrite subtraction of negative product as addition.
3. Compute final addition.

versatileDomains.description: Evaluating net ballistic thrust under opposing gravitational deceleration.
Calculating heat engine energy states from enthalpy deltas.

archetypes.name: Bivariate Signed Algebraic Expression Evaluation (การประเมินค่านิพจน์พีชคณิตจำนวนเต็มสองตัวแปร)
archetypes.coreConcept: Substituting negative values into algebraic terms requires tracking coefficient signs and double negatives. L3 problem form: show a worked solution that makes the mistake 'Failing to turn subtracting a negative product into addition (tag `c03-double-negative-coefficient-leak`)'; the learner finds the faulty step and gives the correct result.
mentalModel: 1. Place negative integers into variable grouping parentheses.
2. Multiply coefficients by signed inputs.
3. Combine resulting positive and negative terms.

cognitiveTraps.description: Failing to turn subtracting a negative product into addition.

versatileDomains.description: Evaluating tension and compression loads on bridge joint nodes.
Evaluating Gibbs free energy from enthalpy and entropy terms.

archetypes.name: Two-Step Linear Equation with Signed Integers (การแก้สมการเชิงเส้นสองขั้นตอนที่เกี่ยวข้องกับจำนวนเต็มลบ)
archetypes.coreConcept: Isolating unknown variables in linear equations involving negative coefficients and negative targets.
mentalModel: 1. Subtract constant from both sides to isolate variable term.
2. Divide both sides by the negative coefficient.
3. Observe negative divided by negative produces positive solution.

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding the constant instead of subtracting when isolating the negative term.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating ballast ejection time during emergency ascent.
Finding duration required to reach designated atmospheric landing zone.

archetypes.name: Multi-Tier Signed Rate Optimization & Net Threshold (แบบจำลองการเปลี่ยนแปลงเชิงอัตราสองมิติของจำนวนเต็ม)
archetypes.coreConcept: Modeling compound real-world systems starting at sub-zero states undergoing uniform positive rate accumulation.
mentalModel: 1. Set initial condition as negative base integer.
2. Compute accumulated change: rate * duration.
3. Add accumulated change to base value to determine final state.

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting the accumulated change from the negative base, worsening deficit.

versatileDomains.description: Predicting drill-bit core temperature at target depth.
Monitoring water volume recovery from initial reservoir deficit.
